resources.string: Your position is used to work out your QTH locator, find the nearest repeaters and APRS stations, and calculate satellite passes and distances to DX stations. GPS only works while the app is open. Online services (the APRS-IS server, repeater databases) only receive the search area; your position becomes visible on the APRS network only after you press “Send position”.
